## Wave 4 Summary

The capstone's load-bearing claim — *"all field content is read from `D_K`"* — is weakest exactly in the matter sector. Cluster **C6** (`_consolidated-findings.md §II C6`, three independent reviewers: paasch, neutrino, dirac) localizes the gap to the `a₄` Seeley-DeWitt coefficient: the Yang-Mills + Higgs + **Yukawa** quartic. The Yukawa/fermion-mass block is the *empty layer* (paasch V.3); the neutrino sector is *entirely absent from the §7 scorecard* despite the `(1,1,0)` singlet sitting in `D_K` (neutrino V.6/V.7); and baryon asymmetry **cannot be sourced internally** because `D_K` is *too CPT-symmetric* (`[J,D_K]=0` at all τ, T11 — a structural prediction, dirac V.3). Dissonance **D5** (`§III D5`) is the only quantitative light-ν mass on record (S60 seesaw `m_2=0.008678 eV`, built on a right-handed Majorana `M_R`) standing against §0's *"no seesaw"* assertion.

This wave converts the C6 + D5 carry-forwards into seven runnable gates, all owned by the matter-sector specialists. The governing structure throughout is the same single spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K(τ), J, γ)`: fermion masses and mixings are the **representation content of `D_K`** — specifically the off-diagonal (Higgs-coupled) entries of the `a₄` Yukawa block — read off the spectrum after inner fluctuation `D_K → D_K + A`. Substrate-first per `phononic-framing.md`: D_K eigenvalues → `a₄` spectral moment → emergent Yukawa matrix → observed mass ratio. No quantity is imported from an external fermion-mass table as a *canonical* pin; external masses (PDG/NuFit) enter ONLY as comparison anchors per `substrate-first-canonical-sourcing.md §(i)`.

The carry-forward source is the §V sections of `paasch-synthesis.md` (V.3, V.4, V.6), `neutrino-synthesis.md` (V.1, V.6, V.7), `dirac-synthesis.md` (V.2, V.3), `nazarewicz-synthesis.md` (relic-charge VAP context), de-duplicated onto the seven distinct-gate seeds enumerated in the context map.

**Classification of the wave**: COMPUTE-class. Every gate produces a number or a definite structural verdict against a pre-registered criterion; none is an artifact-existence/rule-file edit (M1 of `wave-classification.md` fails for all seven — they carry numerical or set-membership thresholds). No allowlist append needed.

    M⁴ × (SU(3), g_τ), using the s66 Clifford construction (C₂ = g₁g₃g₅g₇, C₁ = g₂g₄g₆g₈). The
    SU(3) factor carries B₊ charge-conjugation grading ε″ = +1 (s66), opposite to the finite-SM
    Yukawa ε″ = −1. Compute the overlap ⟨γ₉ Jψ̃ | D_K | ψ̃⟩ on H_K⁺ (γξ = ξ) and test for a nonzero
    chirality-PRESERVING (CPT-non-flipping) component after the Pfaffian restriction. The physical
    Yukawa must FLIP chirality (ε″=−1); a surviving ε″=+1 component is a wrong-chirality residual that
    would enlarge the §1.3.4 capstone caveat from "bounded" to "open."
  producing_script: "computations/session-96/s96_matter_yukawa_chirality.py"

# (1) operator
operator:
  type: "equality"
  form: "residual_chirality_preserving = |⟨γ₉ Jψ̃ | D_K | ψ̃⟩|_{ε″=+1 component on H_K⁺} ; PASS iff < 1e-12"

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "1e-12"
  direction: "<"

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: "Machine-ε THEOREM tolerance (the Pfaffian restriction is an exact projector); the chirality-flip structure follows from γ₉ anticommutation (Jγ₉=−γ₉J, T5) + the H_K⁺ projector definition. The ε″=+1 vs ε″=−1 grading is the s66 product-KO construction."

# (4) reachable_rationals
reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "N/A — exact projector overlap (single structural evaluation to machine-ε)"

# (5) machinery_pin_map
machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: 16               # ℂ¹⁶ single-generation; H_K⁺ projector γξ=ξ; B₊ grading
  L_max: 12                # D_K(τ_fold) blocks from the L_max=12 cache
  scan_range: "N/A — single τ = τ_fold = 0.190 structural evaluation"
  step_size: "N/A"
  tolerance: 1.0e-12       # chirality-preserving residual floor (THEOREM-class machine-ε)
  scheme: "s66-product-KO-Clifford-C2-C1"
  convention: "ABSOLUTE"   # the overlap is a dimensionless structural quantity
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "numpy.linalg"   # 16×16 Clifford — CPU sufficient
  publication_precision: "12"   # machine-ε residual reported to full precision

# (6) audit_discriminators
audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The H_K⁺ restriction projects out the ε″=+1 (wrong-chirality) coupling, recovering ε″=−1."
    Definition 1: C₂ = g₁g₃g₅g₇, C₁ = g₂g₄g₆g₈ (s66 Clifford); J = C₂·K antilinear (T1).
    Definition 2: ε″ = sign of the charge-conjugation grading on the SU(3) factor; s66 gives ε″=+1 on
                  the SU(3)-manifold lift, whereas the finite-SM Yukawa has ε″=−1.
    Definition 3: H_K⁺ = {ξ : γ₉ ξ = +ξ}; γ₉ is the chirality grading, Jγ₉ = −γ₉ J (T5).
    Substitute:   physical Yukawa bilinear Y = ⟨γ₉ Jψ̃ | D_K | ψ̃⟩ restricted to H_K⁺.
    Simplify:     a chirality-FLIPPING coupling pairs γ₉=+ with γ₉=− (off-diagonal in γ₉) ⇒ ε″=−1.
                  a chirality-PRESERVING coupling pairs γ₉=+ with γ₉=+ (diagonal in γ₉) ⇒ ε″=+1 residual.
                  Jγ₉ = −γ₉J ⇒ Jψ̃ has OPPOSITE chirality to ψ̃ ⇒ ⟨γ₉ Jψ̃ | D_K | ψ̃⟩ pairs opposite
                  chiralities ⇒ the leading term is chirality-FLIPPING (ε″=−1) on H_K⁺.
    Canonical form: residual_{ε″=+1} = (projection of Y onto the chirality-preserving channel).
    Direction:    Jγ₉ = −γ₉J FORCES the H_K⁺ bilinear to flip chirality at leading order; the residual
                  ε″=+1 piece should vanish to machine-ε IF the Pfaffian restriction is clean.
    Conclusion:   PASS = residual_{ε″=+1} < 1e-12 (wrong-chirality projected out, SM ε″=−1 recovered).
                  FAIL = nonzero residual ⇒ the §1.3.4 caveat is larger than "bounded" — expand the footnote.

# (8) input_files
input_files:

    path: "computations/_shared/canonical_constants.py"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"
  spectrum_cache_L12:
    path: "computations/session-84/s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz"
    sha256: "<computed-at-runtime>"

    artifact_kind: "script"
    must_contain:

    companion_row_required: true
    schema_v2_3tuple_required: false

    artifact_kind: "wp_section"

    must_contain:
      - "\\*\\*Status\\*\\*:.*COMPLETED"
      - "\\*\\*Verdict\\*\\*:.*(PASS|FAIL|INFO)"
      - "\\*\\*Output Artifacts\\*\\*"
      - "\\*\\*MCP Pre-Compute Audit\\*\\*"

# ---- fb_pair ----
fb_pair:
  forward: "s66 Clifford construction (C₂=g₁g₃g₅g₇, C₁=g₂g₄g₆g₈); D_K(τ_fold) L_max=12 cache; H_K⁺ projector (γξ=ξ); SM branching Ψ₊ (E10); T5 (Jγ₉=−γ₉J)"
  backward: "the §1.3.4 capstone chirality caveat (confirm 'bounded' or expand to 'open'); W4-1 YUKAWA-RATIO (the chirality structure conditions the mass-bilinear extraction); the product-KO 4-vs-6 reading (§V.2)"

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: "The H_K⁺ Pfaffian restriction projects out the ε″=+1 wrong-chirality coupling to machine-ε; the physical SM ε″=−1 chirality-flipping Yukawa is recovered. The §1.3.4 caveat is confirmed 'bounded' (in fact zero). The product-KO Yukawa-chirality sub-finding is CLOSED."
FAIL_meaning: "A nonzero chirality-preserving (ε″=+1) coupling survives the H_K⁺ restriction ⇒ the §1.3.4 caveat is larger than 'bounded'; the capstone footnote must be expanded to an OPEN sub-finding. Informative: the product-KO lift carries a residual wrong-chirality coupling not fully removed by the Pfaffian."
INFO_meaning: "The chirality-preserving coupling is nonzero but is a known measure-zero set absorbed by the Pfaffian normalization (not a physical wrong-chirality channel). Document the measure-zero absorption explicitly; the sub-finding is conditionally closed pending the normalization argument."

# ---- Effort + framing ----

    - "computations/session-96/s96_matter_yukawa_chirality.npz"

substrate_framing: |

  grading (γ₉) and real structure (J), not an external input. Direction: the s66 product-KO Clifford
  construction fixes ε″=+1 on the SU(3) factor; the H_K⁺ Pfaffian restriction (γξ=ξ) + Jγ₉=−γ₉J determine

    ordering), form the squared spacings Δm²₂₁ = m_2²−m_1², Δm²₃₂ = m_3²−m_2², and the dimensionless,
    truncation-robust ratio R = Δm²₃₂/Δm²₂₁ in M_KK units. The bare/zero-mixing value is the
    registry-PROVEN R=27.2 (framework-bbn-hypothesis.md); the closure route adds the weak-mixing
    correction via the S35 analytic formula R ≈ [dE₂₃·(E₃+E₂)]/[dE₁₂·(E₂+E₁)] · [1−V₂₃²/(E₃−E₂)²]/

# (1) operator
operator:

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary

  proof_ref: "NuFit-6.0 R=33.8 (S35 record 32.6±1.4) is the external comparison anchor; the structural bound max[R·sin²θ₂₃]≈3.5 (S35, framework-bbn-hypothesis) constrains the mixing correction; the analytic R formula is session-35-neutrino-baptista-workshop."

  L_max: 10                # bottom-content eigenvalue spacings are L_max-saturated at L_max=10 (Friedrich-Bär)

  tolerance: 1.0e-10       # eigenvalue-spacing residual
  scheme: "direct-DK-eigenvalue-spacing-no-seesaw"
  convention: "RATIO"      # R is dimensionless ⇒ RATIO tolerance class (0.5% on the formula cross-check; band on the verdict)

# (6) audit_discriminators

  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The direct-from-D_K R exceeds the bare R=27.2 toward 33.8 once the weak-mixing correction
            (the term the bare zero-mixing value omits) is included — i.e. mixing INCREASES R."
    Definition 1: bare (zero-mixing) ratio R_0 = (E₃²−E₂²)/(E₂²−E₁²) = [(E₃−E₂)(E₃+E₂)]/[(E₂−E₁)(E₂+E₁)]
                  = 27.2 (registry-PROVEN, framework-bbn-hypothesis).                            [m_i = |λ_i| spacings, m_1=0]
    Definition 2: weak-mixing correction factor F = [1 − V₂₃²/(E₃−E₂)²] / [1 + V₁₂²/(E₂−E₁)²].   [S35 analytic formula]
    Definition 3: V_ij = off-diagonal (inter-generation) couplings, V_ij ≪ dE_ij (weak-mixing limit).
    Substitute:   R = R_0 · F = 27.2 · [1 − V₂₃²/(E₃−E₂)²] / [1 + V₁₂²/(E₂−E₁)²].
    Simplify:     numerator factor (1 − V₂₃²/…) ≤ 1; denominator factor (1 + V₁₂²/…) ≥ 1 ⇒ F ≤ 1.
                  ⇒ R = R_0 · F ≤ R_0 = 27.2.
    Canonical form: R ≤ 27.2 in the weak-mixing limit with this sign convention.
    Direction:    CRITICAL — the naive weak-mixing correction DECREASES R below 27.2, AWAY from 33.8.

                  limit; it requires EITHER strong mixing (V_ij ~ dE_ij, outside the perturbative formula)
                  OR a different E_i spacing (a τ ≠ τ_fold, or a normalization shift). The gate must report
                  the direct R_0 AND test whether ANY admissible spacing/mixing lands R in [30,38].
    Conclusion:   The substitution chain shows the bare R=27.2 PROVEN tag is OVER-TAGGED (neutrino summary
                  row 3): sign + OOM are robust, but no zero-mixing route reaches 33.8, and the perturbative
                  mixing correction moves the WRONG way. PASS only if a non-perturbative or spacing route
                  lands [30,38]; otherwise FAIL/INFO retires the bare PROVEN to §8.5-conditional.

    artifact_kind: "wp_section"

# ---- fb_pair ----
fb_pair:

  backward: "W4-7 SEESAW-D5 (the direct R is the adjudication input for 'is M_R a D_K eigenvalue'); the §7.1 scorecard normal-ordering row; the bare R=27.2 PROVEN-tag retirement decision (§8.5-honest restatement)"

Wave 5 (geometry / causal structure / transition order) does NOT consume Wave 4 outputs — the two waves are structurally independent. No cross-wave decision branching is required.

**Intra-wave branching** (consumed by the orchestrator at wave-execution time):

- **W4-1 (YUKAWA-RATIO)** PASS → the `a₄` matter layer is non-empty; register `R_Yuk` as a canonical constant. FAIL → the gap is the family-number frontier (#7), not the extraction machinery; flag for the §9 frontier ledger. INFO → bare-spectrum geometric ratio pending family structure.
- **W4-2 (PMNS-3X3)** PASS → Level-5 answered; the full PMNS lands; feeds W4-3 m_ββ. FAIL → the B2 wall is a genuine Level-5 obstruction (K7-G1-37); W4-3 m_ββ closes PRE-REG-INC. INFO → partial wall-lift; nonzero angles pending family resolution; W4-3 m_ββ still PRE-REG-INC.

FAIL-excluded → Majorana m_ββ over the bound (hard falsification — re-audit). INFO → Majorana confirmed structurally, m_ββ deferred (W4-2 didn't land masses).
- **W4-4 (EXT-BARYOGEN)** PASS → external frontier #9 located (gravitational channel nonzero, sub-observed). FAIL-internal → CONTRADICTS T11 (re-audit J-action). FAIL-overproduce → emergent normalization wrong. INFO → external channel null too; baryogenesis needs an additional fiber.
- **W4-5 (YUKAWA-CHIRALITY)** PASS → §1.3.4 caveat confirmed bounded (zero residual). FAIL → caveat is OPEN; expand the capstone footnote. INFO → measure-zero residual absorbed by Pfaffian normalization (conditional close).
- **W4-6 (R-HIERARCHY)** feeds W4-7. PASS → R closes onto 33.8 (§7.1 scorecard PASS). INFO (likely per the substitution chain) → retire bare R=27.2 PROVEN to §8.5-conditional. FAIL → direct route fails OOM.
- **W4-7 (SEESAW-D5)** PASS → D5 reconciled (M_R internal). FAIL → S60 superseded / §0 reworded. INFO → structural half confirmed, numerical reconciliation → D5 follow-up workshop.

**Workshop-schedule flags** (per `Investigating-Workshops.md` — D5 is a genuine math/physics adjudication; the compute legs are pre-registered here AND the dissonance may also route to a workshop): **D5** (W4-7) is flagged as a Q1 math/physics-adjudication candidate.
